notes.title: DEVLOG #3
notes.content:
[h1][b]INTRODUCTION[/b][/h1][p]Hey everyone, finally got to write the third devlog of Carnival Massacre. I’ve got plenty of good news about the game’s progress, but also one piece of bad news that I want to get out of the way first…[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/1c8de86ebef5e298c755458106f69d7908985db4.gif"][/img][/p][h2]DELAYING THE GAME A BIT...[/h2][p]My original plan was to release Carnival Massacre in the third quarter of this year, but unfortunately I’ll need to push the release to the fourth quarter of 2025. The reason is simple: like many indie developers, I can’t yet live off game development (yet), so I need to balance a regular job alongside creating the game.[/p][p]I know delays are really icky to hear, but I want my silly carnival game to be a good silly carnival game. Very sorry about the delay, this extra time will be really handy tho. [/p][p]Now for some good news![/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/85fbf471b9d9cb5215bf805985b59c80fe25ac69.gif"][/img][/p][h2]BOSSES!!![/h2][p]I’ve been putting a ton of work into the ringleaders of Carnival Massacre. Tried to make each of kind of unique. I don’t want to spoil too much just yet, so I’ll keep quiet on the details, but I’ve shared a small gif that shows three of them in action.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/0ac1c505b436705b211c2ef529533c9df978fb82.gif"][/img][/p][h2]LEFT WING IS DONE (i think)[/h2][p]The entire left wing of Pebble’s Wonderland is now complete! This area is packed with puzzles, new enemies, new weapons to discover, and of course, boss encounters that push the classic survival horror feel even further. It’s been one of the most content heavy sections so far, really excited for players to explore it.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/d44b03a71f1a9e85e3d9efd28a751163a5efe82b.gif"][/img][/p][h2]MAP[/h2][p]I’ve also added a fully functional map of Pebble’s Wonderland to help players navigate the park. The map highlights objectives, save rooms, locked areas, and more.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/3ef5588a45fa2327ba280c9591b2a4730f81ac45.gif"][/img][/p][h2]NEW "WEAPON"[/h2][p]I’ve decided to add a Polaroid camera to Carnival Massacre! With it you can stun (some) enemies. This opens up new ways to approach encounters: maybe you’ve run out of ammo or want to try a pacifist run, the camera gives you a chance to escape and survive without fighting.[/p][hr][/hr][p]If you’ve got feedback, questions or ideas, drop them in the comments! I read everything! [/p][p]And please wishlist Carnival Massacre if you haven't already.
Also if you are at it, follow me on these super-duper platforms: [/p][p][url="https://bedtimestories.itch.io/"]itch.io[/url] [/p][p][url="https://x.com/bedtimedev"]Twitter/X[/url] [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45515552-BEDTIMEDEV/"]Steam[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks for reading! ❤️[/b] [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
[h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1]
Hey everyone!
First of all, I’m not dead, still grinding away on the game!
Just wanted to share some of the stuff I’ve been working on since the Carnival Massacre demo dropped. Also answering a bunch of questions at the end, including some suggestions you guys sent in. 
[hr][/hr]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/a356f9f5803ace04b6a6ea1b41fcee6fd1f034e1.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/a356f9f5803ace04b6a6ea1b41fcee6fd1f034e1.gif[/img][/url]
[h2]NEW AND REWORKED ENEMIES[/h2]
The base doll enemy’s attack animation was super spammy, so I toned that down a bit. Now you can actually dodge them… sort of.
Also added a few new enemies that’ll show up in the next area of the park. Speaking of new areas…
[hr][/hr]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/e004c8dbe07719b0807bae70375cdd7646d5ff7a.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/e004c8dbe07719b0807bae70375cdd7646d5ff7a.gif[/img][/url]
[h2]LEFT WING IS UNDER CONSTRUCTION[/h2]
The demo covered the right wing of Pebble’s Wonderland. The rest of the game takes place in the left wing, where the four ringleaders are waiting for Harley and Chloe.
Still a lot of work to do on that part so stay with me.
[hr][/hr]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/99c7073eefb61189097d066c18396c09f0ecc06f.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/99c7073eefb61189097d066c18396c09f0ecc06f.gif[/img][/url]
[h2]DOLLY CAMERAS[/h2]
Most areas in Carnival Massacre are pretty linear, which means lots of fixed camera angles.
A solution I really liked from old Silent Hill games was using dolly cameras, the kind that smoothly follow the player along a set path. Got them working, and I’m really happy with how it feels.
[hr][/hr]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/44f111471f61e8218e09bca7d7a130471f92a898.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137772/44f111471f61e8218e09bca7d7a130471f92a898.gif[/img][/url]
[h2]FORTUNE TELLER UPDATE[/h2]
You can now visit the fortune teller to access a shop. It refreshes often and sometimes has discounted stuff. Rarely, it’ll have special one-time items too. The fortune teller still handles saving and storage like in the demo. (also tokens won't take up inventory space anymore, yaaay)
[hr][/hr]
[h2]FAQ[/h2]
Q: Will there be auto aim or aim assist?
A: Yep, auto aim will be in the game and you can turn it on or off anytime.

Q: Will the game have a map?
A: Right now I'm not sure if it’s needed, since the layout isn’t that complex. But I might still change my mind.

Q: Will gamepad support be fixed?
A: Yes. 100%. Working on it.

Q: Ultrawide support?
A: Yeah, resolution settings will be in the options. Left that out of the demo by accident, sorry about that.

Q: Any AI-generated stuff in the game?
A: Nope. Anything that got AI generated got necked before the demo went live.

Q: Copyrighted music?
A: Everything’s either made by me or from a safe, legit music library.

Q: More languages?
A: Only English, sorry.

Q: Are you working alone?
A: Just me, university and a part-time job. :)

[hr][/hr]
If you’ve got feedback, questions or ideas, drop them in the comments! I read everything!
And please wishlist and follow me on these super-duper platforms:
[url=https://bedtimestories.itch.io/]itch.io[/url]
[url=https://x.com/bedtimedev]Twitter/X[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45515552-BEDTIMEDEV/]Steam[/url]

Thanks for reading! ❤️
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: DEVLOG #1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Updated the Demo of My Game![/b][/h1]

[h2]Intro + Spider Boss Fight[/h2]
I decided to change the intro of the game and move the spider boss fight to a different location. I won’t spoil anything, but I’m really happy with the changes, and I intend to keep the intro this way.

[h2]Run Animation and Controls[/h2]
I changed Harley’s run animation — it felt really clunky, so I hope the new one is better. I also made some tweaks to the tank controls. I’ve removed the modern control scheme for controllers for now, as I need a bit more time to work on it. Currently, I recommend playing the game with a keyboard and mouse!

[h2]Music[/h2]
The music that played in the fairgrounds was copyright claimed by someone, somehow, so I tried to compose a similar piece. All the music in the demo is now created by me, so the game is safe for content creation! If your content gets copyright strikes, be sure to message me!

[h2]Map Changes[/h2]
I made some changes to the map in my free time — moved a few items around and added some new paths to explore.

That's it!
[b]The game has already reached 2k+ wishlists![/b]

[h3]Thank you everyone for playing! <3[/h3]
